A few helpful answers

Good questions.
Clear answers.

What is Sena?+

Sena is hospitality software for managing reservations, rooms, guests, payments, your website and everyday property operations.

Do I get a website?+

Yes. Eligible Sena plans include a professionally designed property website connected directly to your rooms and booking experience.

Can I keep my current domain?+

Yes. Your property website can use the domain your guests already know.

Does Sena take commission on bookings?+

Sena doesn't charge a percentage commission on direct reservations under its standard subscription plans. Payment provider fees may apply.

Can my staff have different access?+

Yes. Sena supports staff accounts and role-based access. Account limits and advanced permissions depend on your plan.

Can Sena connect to Booking.com and Airbnb?+

Sena is being built to support external hospitality integrations. Availability depends on the individual platform, market and connection type.

Can I use Sena for multiple hotels?+

Yes. Multi-property options are available for hospitality groups. Talk to us about the right setup for your business.

Can I accept online payments?+

Sena supports payment integrations, beginning with Paystack. Payments are processed by your connected payment provider.
